item.title: Binance hack may involve private key ‘misuse,’ not theft: Blockaid CEO
item.description: Blockaid’s Ido Ben-Natan suspects attackers manipulated Binance’s transaction-signing infrastructure, drawing parallels with the Bybit hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance hack rattles crypto markets as BNB falls 7%, Bitcoin slides
item.description: Bitcoin and Ether tumbled as the broader crypto market fell 3.3%, with reports of suspicious multibillion-dollar transfers from Binance-linked wallets fueling uncertainty.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
item.description: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Live Updates: Binance says $2.54 billion frozen after hack
item.description: Follow live updates as Binance says $2.54 billion in assets has been frozen after a multibillion-dollar hack, with further freezes possible as investigators trace funds.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
item.description: A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
item.description: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
item.description: Hyperliquid’s token pumped following news of ICE and Trade[XYZ] unveiling plans for US perpetual futures.

item.title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
item.description: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
item.description: The tokenized shares would carry the same shareholder rights as traditional stock, with round-the-clock trading and immediate settlement under the SEC’s innovation exemption.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
item.description: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin price jumps to $81.5K as US GDP data beats expectations
item.description: BTC price action returned to a key weekly resistance level as US stock markets digested Alphabet’s Q3 earnings miss.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data
item.description: The French Senate adopted a bill authorizing the automatic exchange of crypto-asset tax information between international tax authorities, pending completion of the legislative process.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
item.description: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin

item.title: Canton Foundation grants RedStone 15.8M Canton Coin for pricing standard
item.description: RedStone’s planned pricing tool will let institutions on Canton use shared market prices without exposing deal terms to data providers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Brazil’s Halloween eve crypto deadline brings more tricks than treats
item.description: Brazil’s crypto exchanges face an application deadline on Friday, with costly requirements and unanswered regulatory questions complicating compliance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Private, fast USDT is coming to Bitcoin. Can it compete with Ethereum and Tron?
item.description: USDT is coming home to Bitcoin, offering privacy and Lightning-fast payments. But can Bitcoin’s revamped version of Tether compete with stablecoins on ETH and TRON?
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
item.description: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

item.title: HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
item.description: HTX has pledged to stop crypto marketing in the UK until October 2031, with deposits and new account registrations already blocked there.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: EU investors rank crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation: OKX survey

item.title: Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption

item.title: Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says

item.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027
item.description: Lagarde announced plans to step down as European Central Bank President after serving more than seven years in the role.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green

item.title: Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
item.description: CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt.

item.title: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police
item.description: Police say at least two cases were reported as early as Sept. 10, nearly a month before the wider incident became public.

item.title: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
